notes: 2003 numbering: Item 14 is Controls and Procedures and Item 15 is exhibits, schedules and reports on Form 8-K; the form had no Items 1A, 1B, 9A, 9B or 16 yet, so none is absent. The contents list (lines 43 to 76) is not labeled; it omits Item 7A, which the body prints. Items 4 and 9 say only 'None' and Items 10, 11 and 13 only incorporate the proxy statement, so they are marked incorporated; Item 12 prints its own part (c) and the equity compensation plan table, so it is not. Item 15 says the exhibits are in the index at page 86; the EXHIBITS INDEX follows directly and stays in Item 15, as in the MONY Group 2004 label. Hard call (uncertain): financial statement schedules II to V (pages 88 to 92, listed under Item 15(a)(2)) follow the exhibit index with no Item heading, then SIGNATURES. Statements with no Item heading belong to no Item, as in the Netflix 2003, ITT 2015 and ACI Worldwide 2021 labels, so Item 15 ends at 'Vesta Insurance Group, Inc.' above 'Schedule II' (line 1775). The alternative keeps them in Item 15 to SIGNATURES, as in fresh2/0000950150-00-000202, but there the Item said the schedules appear at its conclusion, while this Item 15 only gives their page numbers. The filing ends at SIGNATURES.
